facts.page_wording: For every celebration - weddings, honeymoons and the trips in between. The stays, the perks and the support behind every Wedded Wonderland journey, from first idea to homecoming.

facts.claim: Travel enquiries start through the 'Start planning' form on /travel: send dates and destination and the team comes back with a shortlist, the rates and exactly what is included.
facts.page_wording: Send us your dates and destination and we will come back with a shortlist, the rates and exactly what is included.

facts.claim: The shortlist gives two or three options with a clear recommendation, the rate, the cancellation terms and the confirmed inclusions.
facts.page_wording: Two or three options with a clear recommendation, the rate, the cancellation terms and the confirmed inclusions.

facts.claim: Eligible bookings may include daily breakfast, a hotel credit, room upgrade priority, early check-in and late checkout, a welcome amenity, preferred rates and offers, VIP recognition, and extras such as transfers, onboard credit, spa or club access. Inclusions vary by hotel, rate and dates and are confirmed in writing before booking.
facts.page_wording: Daily breakfast ... Hotel credit ... Room upgrade priority ... Early check-in, late checkout ... Welcome amenity ... Preferred rates and offers ... VIP recognition ... Inclusions vary by hotel, rate and dates - we confirm exactly what applies to your stay in writing before you book.
facts.use_note: Always 'may include', never 'includes'. Upgrades and early or late check times are requests, not guarantees (A F-014).

facts.claim: Wonderland Benefits apply at partner, preferred and consortia properties, vary by hotel and program, and are confirmed before the couple commits.
facts.page_wording: Benefits apply at our partner, preferred and consortia properties and vary by hotel and by program. Properties outside these networks may not carry the same perks. Your concierge confirms exactly what your chosen venue includes before you commit.
facts.use_note: Name is 'Wonderland Benefits'; do not use 'Wedded Privileges'.

facts.claim: The concierge is the couple's single point of contact, including handling deposits, payments and currency so nothing gets lost across borders.
facts.page_wording: Your concierge is your single point of contact for all of it: sourcing and securing the venue, negotiating with resorts and airlines, managing room blocks and guest travel, coordinating trusted local vendors, and handling deposits, payments and currency so nothing gets lost across borders.

facts.claim: One dedicated point of contact, with wedding, guest travel and honeymoon under one roof.
facts.page_wording: One Dedicated Point of Contact: No juggling multiple suppliers, planners or travel agents. ... Wedding + Travel Under One Roof: We manage your wedding, guest travel and honeymoon experience.

facts.claim: Fee line, quote exactly: a straightforward hotel booking usually carries no planning fee; more complex itineraries, flights or group work may carry a fee agreed upfront.
facts.page_wording: A straightforward hotel booking usually carries no planning fee. More complex itineraries, flights or group work may carry a fee, agreed with you upfront before any work begins.
facts.use_note: No fee amount published. Do not quote a figure or say the service is free. A multi-stop honeymoon may count as a 'more complex itinerary'.

facts.claim: Scope can be hotel only, the full celebration week, guest travel, honeymoon or all of it, and any planning fee is disclosed before work starts.
facts.page_wording: Hotel only, the full celebration week, guest travel, honeymoon or all of it. If any planning fee applies, you know before we start.

facts.claim: Recommended lead time for a honeymoon is 6 to 9 months to lock in the right suite category (12 to 18 months for a destination wedding).
facts.page_wording: For a destination wedding, 12-18 months is the comfortable lead time ... For a honeymoon, 6-9 months is ideal to lock in the right suite category
facts.use_note: Cite /destination-packages. The lead time was not found on /destination-honeymoon-packages today.

facts.page_wording: We can stage the wedding at one resort and the honeymoon at another (or extend the same stay), with one specialist coordinating the whole trip

facts.claim: Australian Consumer Law consumer guarantees apply to travel services whether booked directly with the provider, through a travel agent, or through a third party such as a booking platform or package provider.
If a delayed or cancelled travel service is not replaced within a reasonable time, the provider must give the consumer their choice of a different replacement service or a refund.

No replacement or refund is required under the consumer guarantees if the consumer changes their mind, misses the service for unrelated reasons, or a third party such as a government restriction prevents it; rights then depend on the booking terms.

When booking through a travel agent, both the agent's and the primary provider's terms apply; agents are usually bound by the provider's terms and may legally only need to pass on the provider's remedy.
facts.use_note: A planner does not add legal rights beyond the supplier's; the value is in reading and negotiating terms.

facts.claim: ACCC tips: allow extra time between connections, check the agent's and supplier's terms (including any force majeure term) before booking, and ask for unclear terms in writing.
The ACCC does not resolve individual travel complaints; contact the provider first, then escalate to state or territory consumer agencies or tribunals.
Smartraveller says the right travel insurance is as essential as a passport for overseas travel, for every traveller.
Always read the Product Disclosure Statement (PDS) before buying travel insurance.
Choose a policy covering every country on the trip including stopovers and transit points, and check whether cancellation is covered if the advice level rises after booking.
Insurers exclude many activities from standard policies (even common ones such as cruises); check the included and excluded activities list.
Policies often limit each valuable item's value; check item limits and the excess. Free credit card insurance often covers fewer situations with lower limits and usually has to be activated.
Travel insurance can cover cancellation costs if plans change; basic medical-only policies usually do not cover cancellation or property.
Medical assistance is usually the highest unexpected cost for Australians overseas, and the Australian Government cannot pay travellers' bills.
Smartraveller's essentials checklist says to confirm your passport is valid for at least 6 months beyond the end of your trip.
facts.page_wording: Confirm your passport is valid for at least 6 months beyond the end of your trip.

facts.claim: Some countries won't let you enter unless your passport is valid for six months after you plan to leave; some airlines impose this rule themselves; it can apply when transiting; getting it wrong can mean being stranded.
facts.page_wording: Some countries won't let you enter unless your passport is valid for six months after you plan to leave that country. Some airlines also impose this rule on their own initiative. It can apply even if you're just transiting or stopping over. ... Getting it wrong can mean being stranded.

facts.claim: Allow at least 6 weeks to get a passport; where possible, don't book flights without a valid passport.
facts.page_wording: Allow at least 6 weeks to get your passport. Child applications can sometimes take longer. Where possible, don't book flights without a valid passport.

facts.claim: If you change your family name because of marriage, you can get a new passport or keep using your current one, and the Australian Passport Office recommends booking travel in the name that is in your passport.
facts.page_wording: If you change your family name because of a change in your marital status, you can choose to get a new passport or keep using your current one. We recommend booking travel in the name that's in your passport.
facts.use_note: Key honeymoon point: book in the name on the passport you will carry.

facts.claim: A married-name passport needs documents linking the names, generally an Australian RBDM-issued marriage certificate; Australians born in Australia who marry overseas always need a name change certificate. The replacement fee may be waived if the name changed due to marriage and the current passport expires more than 2 years from now, subject to criteria.
facts.page_wording: marriage certificate issued by an Australian RBDM ... you were born in Australia and married or entered into a registered relationship overseas ... You may be eligible to have the application fee for your replacement passport waived

facts.claim: A curated honeymoon package is contrasted with all-inclusive: all-inclusive bundles one resort's meals, drinks and activities into one price, while a curated package starts with the couple and is designed, not pre-set.

A curated honeymoon package is built in reverse: the itinerary starts with you ... the package itself is designed, not pre-set.

facts.page_wording: Whether you want barefoot and unplugged, multi-stop and adventurous, or quietly cocooned in one villa for ten days, the package is built around the trip you actually want, not a fixed template.
